independent_pde_check.interpretation: mapping-consistency only; not converged truth or semantic-coverage evidence

interpretation.claim_scope: one-seed one-budget mapping-only feasibility pilot; not H2

limitations.arm_shuffle_confound: scratch and transfer use different arm-seeded epoch permutations as well as different initialization; this one-seed pilot cannot attribute an observed arm difference solely to transfer initialization
